method: Node115's .comment names rustc 1.95.0 (59807616e 2026-04-14) and LLD 22.1.2. Each function section in the published std rlibs is compared with every node115 .text FDE of identical length, wildcarding only the 4-byte fields named by its own PC-relative/GOT relocation records. A record is kept only when the masked body has exactly one complete-FDE hit and every non-relocation byte is equal.
limits: Only std functions emitted out-of-line in the published rlibs; generic/inlined std code instantiated in node crates is not covered.
Relocation fields are masked, not resolved; GOTPCRELX relaxation would surface as a non-relocation difference and is therefore excluded rather than normalized.
Ambiguous bodies (several node115 FDEs or several std symbols) are dropped.
No first-party component credit, gate or behavior claim.
